issues.description: Inner-template contradiction about the 'setup' routine's parameters: template_repository/helloWorld.asm contains the comment 'Setup routine taking no parameters (PS requires 1 arg)' which asserts both that the routine takes no parameters and that the PS requires 1 argument. This is internally contradictory and can confuse students about whether 'setup' expects an argument. The solution implementation does not include a 'setup' label at all, which makes the parenthetical remark ('PS requires 1 arg') in the template look incorrect or outdated.
issues.suggested_fix: Clarify or remove the contradictory parenthetical in the template. Either (a) state unambiguously that 'setup' takes no parameters (e.g. 'Setup routine taking no parameters') and remove '(PS requires 1 arg)'; or (b) if a parameter is actually required in some contexts, document that clearly and ensure the solution/template consistently include and use the setup label. Given the solution omits 'setup', the simplest fix is to remove the '(PS requires 1 arg)' text so the comment reads that the routine takes no parameters.
